metrics.title: Return on assets
metrics.description: Profitability relative to the asset base; retained separately from environmental performance.

metrics.title: Revenue growth
metrics.description: Period-over-period revenue change with an explicit comparison basis.

metrics.title: Current ratio
metrics.description: Current assets relative to current liabilities.

metrics.description: Supporting liquidity evidence; no universal pass threshold is assumed.

metrics.title: Debt to assets
metrics.description: Supporting leverage information for investor review.

metrics.title: Project cost
metrics.description: Total cost of the proposed project.

metrics.title: Expected annual savings
metrics.description: Projected annual savings, retained as a projection rather than achieved performance.
